src/features/canvas-editor/components/ca: The editor's public entry point. Two surfaces open it (the review work column and the calendar card) and neither has any business reaching further in — this being the only canvas-editor file they import is the boundary working, not leaking.
src/features/canvas-editor/lib/auto-comp: The editor's SECOND public entry point: bake a slide's text without opening the editor. Three surfaces call it and none of them render a canvas. It stays inside the feature because it is the only thing that legitimately reaches the editor's internals — compose, save-canvas, canvas-state-client and resolve-slides are all its private dependencies. Lifting it to src/lib/ would drag four browser-only modules with it and turn a feature-internal call graph into four lib->features imports, which is worse than the orphan it fixes.
